question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Deficient
solution:
The correct answer is **"lacking"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Look at the meaning of the given word:
 
 
• **Deficient**- not having enough of a specified quality or ingredient, less in quantity.

 
 
• ​Example- This diet is **deficient** in Vitamin C.
 
 
 
 
 
• Look at the meaning of given words in the options:
 
 
• **​Lacking- **less in quantity.​
 
• **Bold-** confident and courageous
 
• **Challenging-** tough.
 
• **Difficult -** tough.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that *lacking* will be the right answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
